title: Competitive Service Act of 2015
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was passed by the House on February 29, 2016. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Competitive Service Act of 2015

(Sec. 2) This bill authorizes an appointing authority (i.e., a federal agency appointing an individual to a position in the competitive service), other than the appointing authority that requested a certificate of eligibles for filling a position, to select an individual from that certificate for appointment to a position that is: (1) in the same occupational series as the position for which the certificate of eligibles was issued, and (2) at a similar grade level as the original position. The appointing authority must select an individual from the certificate of eligibles within 240 days after the issuance of the certificate. The bill sets forth further requirements relating to the sharing of certificates by agencies, notice to agency employees of available positions, and alternative ranking and selection procedures for job applicants.

summary.headline: This law lets federal agencies share lists of qualified job applicants with each other for similar positions.
summary.what_it_does: Federal agencies hire from lists called certificates of eligibles, which name applicants who qualified for a job. Under this law, an agency other than the one that requested the list may pick someone from it for a job in the same occupational series at a similar grade level. The selecting agency must choose from the list within 240 days after it was issued. The law also sets rules for sharing these certificates, notifying agency employees about open positions, and using alternative ranking and selection methods.

who_it_affects.group: Job applicants on federal hiring certificates of eligibles
who_it_affects.how: Their names may be considered by more than one federal agency for matching positions, and selections must be made within 240 days.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that hire competitive service employees
who_it_affects.how: They may select candidates from certificates requested by other agencies and must follow new rules for sharing certificates and notifying employees.

who_it_affects.group: Current federal employees in the competitive service
who_it_affects.how: They must be notified of available positions under the law's notice requirements.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted March 18, 2016; the summary does not specify a separate effective date for each provision.
